transcribed_question:
A) What Structure is inserted on the area painted GREEN
B) What Structure passes through Area Painted Pink

marker.description: Green paint on the distal lateral aspect of the bone

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the green paint.
main_explanation: The green paint is located on the lateral prominence of the distal femur, which is the lateral epicondyle.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is attached to the structure indicated by the green paint?
supporting_question.explanation: The lateral collateral ligament (fibular collateral ligament) attaches to the lateral epicondyle of the femur.
